summary: First iteration of MVP tests for Rosas Auto Works. Ran pytest (17 backend tests) — 15 passed, 2 failed. Key services / availability / bookings / admin auth flows all work. Stripe /api/payments/checkout returns 500 due to Stripe test-account tax config, which BLOCKS the entire deposit / booking-completion flow (both API and UI). Frontend home + booking wizard + admin route protection verified with Playwright.

critical.issue: Returns 500. Stripe error: 'You must have a valid head office address to enable automatic tax calculation in test mode.' Cause: server.py passes automatic_tax={'enabled': True} but the connected Stripe test account has no office address. This blocks the entire booking flow (Pay $100 Deposit button on frontend fails). Fix: remove automatic_tax={'enabled': True} (or set to False) from stripe.checkout.Session.create in /app/backend/server.py:450-459, or configure the Stripe dashboard tax settings. Since deposit is a fixed $100 and billing address is already collected, disabling automatic tax is the simplest fix.

minor.issue: Slot conflict detection is not atomic — availability lookup + insert is a race window (two concurrent requests could both see slot as available). Consider a unique compound index on (booking_date, time_slot) filtered by status != 'cancelled', or use a transactional pattern.
Could not fully validate because /payments/checkout fails; only 404 path is testable. Re-test after Stripe fix.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=booking-pay-btn] on the final step creates the booking (POST /api/bookings 200) but then /api/payments/checkout returns 500 → user is left on the last step. A toast is triggered in code but was not clearly rendered in DOM within our capture window; consider adding a persistent inline error banner in the summary card. Root cause is the Stripe automatic_tax config (see backend critical).

Only next 21 days are exposed as buttons in the UI (dates array in Booking.jsx). Fine, but there is no visual feedback when a user's chosen day is a Sunday other than opacity — button is disabled but no tooltip / 'closed' text; acceptable but a small polish item.

issues: Booking flow, home hero, service grid, admin login, admin route protection all render correctly. No contrast/spacing issues observed.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix Stripe checkout 500 — remove automatic_tax={'enabled': True} from stripe.checkout.Session.create in /app/backend/server.py, OR configure a valid head office address on the Stripe test account. Without this, no booking can be completed.
Add a unique index / atomic guard on booking_date+time_slot to eliminate the availability→insert race.
Consider showing a persistent inline error (not just a toast) on the final booking step when checkout fails so users know to retry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:450 — automatic_tax enabled without required Stripe account config causes 500. Either disable or gate behind an env flag.

server.py:344-377 — Booking creation uses availability() function call then insert, no atomic guard. Two simultaneous requests for the same slot could both succeed. Add unique index or use find_one_and_update / conditional insert.
server.py:474 — _mark_paid handles idempotency well via update filter, good.
server.py — Stripe secret webhook signature is validated, good. Emergent email failures are swallowed (non-blocking), consistent with spec.
server.py — Consider adding server-side email format & phone normalization; EmailStr already validates email.
Frontend Booking.jsx — On 409 conflict it correctly jumps back to step 2 to let user pick another slot. Good.

success_rate.backend: 88% (15/17 passing; 2 fail solely due to Stripe automatic_tax config)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (all UI navigation & steps work; final Stripe redirect blocked by backend 500)

context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers services, availability (Mon/Sat/Sun), bookings (create/get/invalid service/Sunday reject/409 conflict), payments (checkout+status), and full admin gating (401/403/200 + status update + reschedule). After main agent fixes the Stripe automatic_tax issue, re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Also re-verify the booking→Stripe redirect on the frontend using [data-testid=booking-pay-btn] — should navigate to a checkout.stripe.com URL.
rca of the issue: POST /api/payments/checkout in /app/backend/server.py builds a Stripe Checkout Session with automatic_tax={'enabled': True}. The Stripe test account associated with STRIPE_SECRET_KEY does not have a head office address configured, so Stripe rejects the request with InvalidRequestError: 'You must have a valid head office address to enable automatic tax calculation in test mode.' FastAPI converts the uncaught exception into a 500 response. Reproduction: 1) POST /api/bookings (returns 200), 2) POST /api/payments/checkout {booking_id, origin_url} → 500. Mitigation: (a) fastest — remove automatic_tax argument (deposit is a flat $100, no tax needed); (b) or set enabled=False; (c) or set a head office address in the Stripe dashboard test-mode tax settings.
